background: CaixaBank is Spain's largest domestic bank by loans and deposits, formed from the la Caixa savings bank and its takeover of Bankia, with a retail, insurance and asset-management franchise concentrated in Spain and Portugal.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ from Fitch, A+ from S&P and A2 from Moody's, all stable, with Fitch's upgrade to A+ on 8 Jul 2026 the latest move. Capital is the weak side against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 12.3% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median and leverage of 5.5% is at the median. Liquidity is a real strength, with LCR of 193% and NSFR of 143% both in the top quarter, though LCR has fallen 14 points and NSFR 6 points since 30 Jun 2025. The flagged news is good: first-half profit up on 29 Jul 2026 and the Fitch upgrade on 8 Jul 2026.
